pages.name: Annual cron blocked until #183
pages.description: The annual billing cron stays disabled until #183 lands.
pages.excerpt: The annual cron is blocked: it double-charged three families in August. Keep it off until #183 adds the idempotency key.

pages.name: Staging shares the production database host
pages.description: Staging and production run on one Postgres host.
pages.excerpt: Staging uses the same Postgres host as production, on another database. A migration run against the wrong URL hits production.

pages.name: Answer in Portuguese
pages.description: Replies to the user are in Portuguese.
pages.excerpt: The user writes and reads in Portuguese; code and commit messages stay in English.
